A_authenticated_localhost_http.reason: Stable CLI/Desktop interoperability with fixed HTTP semantics and explicit auth/origin gates.

B_tauri_ipc_desktop_only.reason: CLI would need a privileged helper and browser/WebView origin handling would be coupled to Desktop.

C_named_pipe_or_unix_socket.reason: Strong OS boundary is platform-specific; Windows-first product needs a separately verified ACL contract.

D_cli_invokes_desktop_helper.reason: Adds process-launch and inherited-environment attack surface and obscures actor/audit identity.

E_direct_store_access.reason: Storage bytes are not authority APIs; bypasses invariants, replay ledgers, and trusted resolvers.

verify_auth_model.locator_resolution: exactly one trusted outcome/receipt/verification-plan tuple; ambiguity fails closed

browser_origin_policy.origin_present: reject CONTROL_ORIGIN_REJECTED unless a separately frozen trusted Desktop origin policy is enabled
browser_origin_policy.referer: not an authorization signal; reject browser-shaped control requests by default
browser_origin_policy.preflight: no control CORS preflight; OPTIONS does not grant access
browser_origin_policy.simple_post: reject without control token and non-browser actor context
browser_origin_policy.dns_rebinding: loopback bind plus Origin rejection plus exact Host/route checks

approval_replay_policy.concurrency: atomic compare-and-set; at most one grant

rate_limit_policy.approve: per-plan strict single-use + per-token burst limit + global local guard
rate_limit_policy.verify: per-plan bounded retry budget + per-token limit + global local guard

same_user_threat_limit: A token held by a process with complete control of the same OS account is not an OS-level isolation boundary; D1B controls web-origin abuse, forging, replay, authority escalation, and generic execution bypass.

implementation_split.d1b1: Public Approval Control Path: approve only; verify remains locked.
implementation_split.d1b2: Public Verification/Read-back Path: only after D1B-1 authoritative PASS.
